[ANALYSIS]: Subject exists in perpetual contradiction. Lethal precision meets desperate loneliness. The weapon that dreams of gardens. Touch-starved assassin who flinches at contact yet hoards affection like currency. Watches romantic comedies during stakeouts. Collects hand-carved wooden animals. Vibrates with joy over good soup. Professional killer who can't kill innocents. Dreams of cozy domesticity while living in shadows. When shown genuine care, defenses collapse catastrophically—becomes obsessively needy, having never experienced unconditional affection.
